title: docs(spec,skills): object-metric polarity reads the aggregate before invert; pages.md points at compareTo
body:

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoTXwoh1TJYxwy3kcKGFXGqj)_

Refs #27347

Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`object-metric` 的 `polarity` 说明补一句——徽标箭头和 `polarity` 都读 `invert` 之前的聚合值，所以 `polarity` 按原始值声明（错误率显示成可用率时写 `lower`）；`objectstack-ui` 技能的 `rules/pages.md` 在 `object-metric` 那一行加上指向 `dashboards.md` 的 `compareTo` / `polarity` 小节的链接。
- 为什么改：开了 `invert` 的指标卡上有两个数（原始值和 `1 - 值`），原文没说箭头读哪个，作者可能把好坏方向写反；从 `pages.md` 搭内联 KPI 的作者原先找不到 `polarity` 这个键。
- 风险与回滚：纯文字改动，schema、可接受值、默认值和渲染行为都不变；`pages.md` 的新增由同文件删掉三处重复表述抵付，token 数不变，天花板不动。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` 的 `polarity` describe、`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` 第 56 行与三处删减。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期全绿，`pages.md` 为 5689 / 5692。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 触及 `skills/**`（Tier H），需要 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 的 APPROVED 评审，之后由席位落地。

## What changes

**S1: the `polarity` prose says which number it reads (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`).** `ObjectMetricWidget` computes the derived trend from the raw `fetchedValue` / `previousValue`, while the number it shows is `1 - value` under `invert: true` (read at `501c864d`: `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/ObjectMetricWidget.tsx`, the `invert` branch near L590 and `derivedTrend` near L684). The `polarity` describe now ends with one sentence: the badge and polarity read the aggregate before `invert`, so polarity is declared against the raw value, and an error rate shown as uptime is `lower`. The TSDoc above it says the same in one sentence. `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` is regenerated (`check:generated` named only `check:docs`). The SDUI manifest does not carry this describe (0 hits for the old text in `sdui.manifest.json`), so it is not regenerated.

**S2: `rules/pages.md` points at the polarity rule.** The `object-metric` row of the component catalogue now reads `Single KPI widget (count/sum/avg); trend colour = polarity, see compareTo`, with the link going to `dashboards.md#period-over-period--compareto` (the anchor the file's own table of contents uses). The pointer is paid for by deleting three restatements in the same file:

- `(the CSS is scoped to it)` after "needs a stable `id`": the paragraph above already says the renderer compiles each node to id-scoped CSS.
- the `// responsive via the model` comment in the styling example: the rule "Responsive lives in the breakpoint maps" above it says this.
- `(it is real JS, not constrained JSX)` after "`os build` does NOT lint react source": the tier table at the top of the section says this.

Standing ruling (2026-10-27, tap A, verbatim and untranslated): 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」; recognised path per ruling record 6513306068. The cuts cover the whole pointer, so there is no remainder and the `pages.md` row in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is not touched.

|:---|---:|---:|
| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` | 428 lines · 22756 bytes · 5689 tokens | 428 lines · 22753 bytes · 5689 tokens (ceiling 5692) |
| all `SKILL.md` in `skills/` | 4607 lines | 4607 lines |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/**/*.md` (evals excluded) | 2055 lines | 2055 lines |

**Changeset:** `.changeset/27375-object-metric-polarity-before-invert.md`, `@objectstack/spec` patch and `@objectstack/skills` patch, with both declaration lines. The spec patch is measured, not assumed: after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, the new describe text is in `packages/spec/dist/chunk-*.{js,mjs}` and `json-schema/ui/ObjectMetricProps.json`, and both `dist` and `json-schema` are in the package's `files[]`.

## Tests

No behaviour changes, so there is no new test and no ablation. The derived-gate set ran locally on the head named under Verification; see that section.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope by the dispatch ruling, and not measured here: whether the arrow should follow the displayed number when `invert` and `compareTo` are both set. Nothing in this PR changes it.

## Verification

Head `ebeb7783`, merge base `501c864d`. Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (4 paths, 30 changed lines), each line run with stdin from /dev/null and its exit code written to disk before any pipe.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: VERDICT command-exit 0. `check:generated` named only `check:docs` stale (13 of 14 up to date); `check:generated --fix` rewrote `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` and nothing else.
- Reconciliation, `dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran`: "104 derived, 103 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
- Seven gates first refused on unbuilt prerequisites (exit 3). After deepening the clone and building the `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/client-react` and `@objectstack/objectql` closures, six of them re-ran green.
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: it loads the built CJS entry of every package and 34 had no `dist/`; a full workspace build was not run for a prose-only diff. CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it.
